content:
Daria: Proposing a small "safety-gate" for precision profile swaps that we can ship quickly. Goal: avoid silent quality regressions during kernel substitution.
Ken: high level ok. what are the primitives?
Daria: three primitives: 1) explicit mapping table (name -> effective_profile) 2) per-profile quant_fingerprint (hash) 3) a fast conservative check (similarity metric + required metadata) that gates fast-path swaps.
Samir: similarity metric = cosine on per-tensor scales + structural match. threshold configurable per-tenant. If below threshold, require canonicalize-on-deploy.
Lara: For observability, runtime should emit header X-precision-resolve: orig=<orig_profile>;resolved=<effective_profile>;path=<fast|canon>;sim=<0.96>;kernel=<k_42>. That lets us join with evals.
Daria: Config example for ops teams:
```
precision_gate:
  default: pass-through
  tenants:
    enterprise-ops: require_canonicalize
  mappings:
    "vendor/alpaca/fp8-mini": "redwood/int8/alpaca-safe-1"
  safety:
    similarity_threshold: 0.93
    shadow_sample: 80
    live_ramp: [1,5,20,100]
```
Ken: Good. Need onboarding lint: reject mapping if quant_fingerprint missing or if per-tensor scales absent. Owners must ack ambiguous mappings.
Samir: Regression detection: compute deg_score per resolved profile; if live deg_delta > 0.02 within 10m, auto-disable mapping and trigger shadow-replay.
Lara: ops-bot: runbook sketch:
```
monitor: deg_score, p95_latency, fallback_rate
trigger: if deg_delta > 0.02 OR fallback_rate > 0.5% -> disable mapping, notify owner, start shadow-compare
rampdown: flip to canonicalize or rollback to orig profile
```
Daria: privacy note: quant_fingerprint should be a non-reversible hash, and telemetry sampling must respect tenant retention settings.
Ken: perf note: when switching to a different kernel family warm up KV cache with 5 short prompts before measuring latency. Avoid false positives.
Samir: action items: 1) Daria -> doc the gate schema, 2) Ken -> onboarding lint + owner-ack flow, 3) Lara -> header + logging patch, 4) Samir -> eval join and deg_score alerting.
ops-bot: ticket QUANT-GATE-501 created and assigned to eng-ml.
Daria: let's keep fast-path opt-in per-model until we have two weeks of stable telemetry. Sync Tue for review. :thumbsup:
